decisions.reason: Requiring the public total-mints statistic to match completed mints does not change referral-count accuracy on the leaderboard.
The source separately reports personal referrals, tickets, and badge values, but the total-mints requirement does not change the dashboard reward-summary attributes.
Public total completed mints and the NFTs owned by the current user are distinct counts; the dashboard ownership-listing requirement remains unchanged.
The total-mints statistic does not alter the requirement for accurate referrals, tickets, and earnings on an individual NFT detail view.
The source decision concerns aggregate completed-mint counting and does not change the surviving Small Block ticket metadata counter.
Aggregate mint-count accuracy has no necessary effect on whether NFT metadata and asset endpoints resolve.
The public total-mints statistic does not change NFT image, information, cover, or book-link presentation requirements.
The landing-page book-cover placement, sizing, cropping, and visibility requirements are unaffected by aggregate mint-count accuracy.
The source does not request any revision to About-page copy; references to minting in that copy remain valid unchanged.
The aggregate-statistics correction does not logically require a change to the approved FAQ content.
The total-mints statistic is separate from the landing-page hero copy, mechanics preview, CTA, and layout.
Correcting the public total-mints count does not change SIWE authentication for crypto mint and transfer flows.
